remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Published in Chatham Episcopal Institute yearbook, *Mortar Board*, 1905, of which O'Keeffe was art editor. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Reproduction of signed illustration. Two rectangular tennis racquets cross one another, creating an X-shape. The words "Racquet Club" appear on the sports equipment. Three tennis balls sit on the ground in front of a net. Text below the scene reads "Colors: Scarlet and White", "Flower: Chrysanthemum", "Object: A Hot Game of Tennis".
dimensions: 6 1/8 x 8 or 8 x 6 1/8 inches, sheet, orientations vary
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
